fields.notes: PROFINET's test surface is the in-band DCP/LLDP/SNMP, the per-frame APDU status and IOPS/IOCS, and the acyclic diagnosis/I&M records plus the Alarm-CR. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST is an implementation concern. Conformance is certified by PI per conformance class.

in_band_test_facilities.name: DCP
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Discover and physically locate stations (flashing) for commissioning/debug.

in_band_test_facilities.name: APDU status / IOPS/IOCS
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Per-frame liveness, validity, and station-problem indication.

internal_diagnostics_observability: PTCP sync status; MRP ring status.
out_of_band_test_facilities: PI conformance test tools per conformance class (CC-A/CC-B/CC-C).

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
